# ThruHike Crew

ThruHike Crew brings together people interested in helping ThruHike. The public Crew page is https://thruhike.ru/crew and applications are disabled.

The project owner is the sole first maintainer/moderator. Public Issues are limited to safe, factual observations based on already-public pages and repository documents. Do not submit personal data, private information, security findings, proposals, or implementation requests.

Until separate licensing and intellectual-property terms are approved, no pull requests, code, text, images, designs, maps, route data, or other materials are accepted. `support@thruhike.pro` is only for privacy/data questions, consent withdrawal, and deletion requests. Use the Security tab's private **Report a vulnerability** route for security.

Participation does not guarantee payment, employment, equity, ownership, or other rights.
